dct_description_sm: The goal of the Cape Bounty Arctic Watershed Observatory (CBAWO) has been to undertake integrated hydrological and geomorphological research in paired watersheds, to determine the impact and feedbacks between hydroclimatic change and landscape stability in the Canadian High Arctic. At the West Station (named 'WestMet'), year-round, systematic measurements of air temperature and rainfall are collected at hourly intervals.
dct_title_s: 2003-2019 Climate Data, West Station, Cape Bounty, Nunavut
